intro.h2: Remodels that respect your budget and your home
paragraphs: RC General Remodeling is the trade name of Solution Rodri LLC, a kitchen and bathroom remodeling business based at 10251 SW 5th Ct in Pembroke Pines, FL. Customers know us through Yasiel, who one homeowner says did an exceptional job on her remodel, stayed accommodating and worked within her budget. She has since sent friends and neighbors our way.

Our photos show how we work. Before demolition we hang plastic sheeting to close off the room, and the crew wears shoe covers in the hallway. Reviews mention attention to detail, punctuality and a fair price, and one customer simply calls our work safe, fast and quality.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: From the vanity wall to the lighting, we rebuild bathrooms around how you use them. One finished bath has two white vessel sinks on dark wood vanities, a storage cabinet between them, black framed mirrors and a three-globe light above.

image.alt: Bathroom with two white vessel sinks on espresso vanities, black framed mirrors and a three-globe light fixture

items.name: Kitchen updates
items.blurb: A kitchen can feel new without starting from scratch. In the kitchen shown, espresso painted cabinets sit above a silver glass mosaic backsplash, with a stainless range and dishwasher and dark wood-look plank floors running through the room.

image.alt: Kitchen with espresso painted cabinets, a glass mosaic backsplash, stainless appliances and wood-look plank floors

items.name: Bathroom repairs and rebuilds
items.blurb: Sometimes a remodel starts with what is behind the wall. We open damaged lower walls down to the studs and plumbing, check what is there, then rebuild. The bath in these photos had its old vanity out and the walls opened before new work began.

image.alt: Bathroom mid-repair with the vanity removed, lower walls opened to the studs and plumbing, and a marble-look tile tub surround

about.h2: About Solution Rodri LLC and RC General Remodeling
about.text: Solution Rodri LLC does business as RC General Remodeling and works out of Pembroke Pines, FL. The business identifies as Latino-owned. Yasiel is the name customers mention in reviews, and replies to every review come in the first person, thanking each customer for the trust they placed in him to complete their project. Customers describe the team as committed, punctual and careful with details. We take on kitchens, bathrooms and the repairs that come up along the way, and we answer the phone six days a week.

service_area.h2: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling in Pembroke Pines, FL
service_area.text: We are based at 10251 SW 5th Ct in Pembroke Pines, FL, and our reviews come from homeowners here. Google does not list a wider service area for us yet. If your home is nearby but outside the city, call (786) 365-8840 between 7 AM and 7 PM, Monday to Saturday, and tell us where you are and what you need done.

items.q: Do you remodel both kitchens and bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. Our photos show a finished bathroom with a double vessel sink vanity, a kitchen with espresso painted cabinets and a glass mosaic backsplash, and a bathroom being opened up and repaired. Call us to talk through what your room needs and we will tell you what makes sense.

items.q: Can you work with my budget?
items.a: That is one of the things customers mention most. One homeowner says Yasiel was very accommodating and worked within her budget, and another calls our price fair. Tell us your number at the start and we will plan the work around it.

items.q: How do you keep dust out of the rest of the house?
items.a: Before we tear anything out, we close off the work area with plastic sheeting taped from floor to ceiling. The crew wears shoe covers in the hallways, and debris goes straight into bags so it does not travel through your home.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 7 AM to 7 PM and closed on Sunday, which makes early mornings and Saturdays easy. You can call (786) 365-8840 during those hours, or email info.rcremodelingflorida@gmail.com with photos of the space and the best time to reach you.

items.q: Is Solution Rodri LLC the same company as RC General Remodeling?
items.a: Yes. RC General Remodeling is the name Solution Rodri LLC does business under, which is why you may see either name on our Google profile and in our reviews. One customer even writes it as Solution Rodry. It is the same team either way.

final_cta.text: Call Yasiel and the RC General Remodeling team, Monday to Saturday.
